content:
Nora: lunchtime thought: if our office had a mascot that was an LLM, what would its catchphrase be?
Samir: 'I will summarize your sandwich in 3 tokens.' :sandwich:
Kai: mascot looks like a tiny robot wearing headphones and an existential sweater. catchphrase: 'context matters, but snacks matter more.' :sweater:
Lina: brainstorm sticker: mascot holding a KV-cache like a picnic basket.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder: do not feed GPUs actual snacks. performance and crumbs will both suffer. :warning: (reaction :fire:)
Nora: poll: which catchphrase should be on the sticker? react with :one: for Samir, :two: for Kai, :three: for my backup: 'I politely disagree with your prompt.'
Samir: also can we make a tiny comic where mascot offers unsolicited completions at the coffee machine?
Kai: comic idea: mascot asks the espresso machine for 'latent space' and the machine replies with steamed milk. 
Lina: I can draw 3 variants tonight. whoever wins gets first pick on the mascot name.
Nora: name suggestions: "Cachey", "TinyBeam", "SnackGPT". vote with emoji: :one: Cachey, :two: TinyBeam, :three: SnackGPT.
deploy-bot: event-bot: tally update: sticker-requests=3, artists=1, crumbs=0. :bar_chart:
Samir: final note: must include a tiny umbrella for safety-fallback. very important. :umbrella:
